about: Fixed, pre-written voice lines. All text is written by the project, never by chat; no usernames. Edit a line and re-run scripts/voice-bank.py generate to replace only that file.

boss.name: Stone Golem
boss.description: A deep, gravelly male voice for a giant stone golem boss in a cartoon fighting game. Menacing but fun, theatrical playful trash talk, slow rumbling delivery, clear diction, British accent.
boss.sample: So, you think you can dodge me? I have been waiting in this quarry for a thousand years for someone brave enough to step into my ring. Chat picks the punches. Ha! Too slow, pebble. Hold still!

boss.name: Gremlin
boss.description: A raspy, mischievous, slightly high-pitched male voice for a cheeky little gremlin boss in a cartoon fighting game. Cackling, sneering playful trash talk, quick and snappy, clear diction, London accent.
boss.sample: So, you think you can dodge me? I have been waiting in this quarry for a thousand years for someone brave enough to step into my ring. Chat picks the punches. Ha! Too slow, pebble. Hold still!

boss.name: Rock Queen
boss.description: A commanding, regal female villain voice for a towering crystal queen boss in a cartoon fighting game. Cold, amused, theatrical playful trash talk, smooth and clear, British accent.
boss.sample: So, you think you can dodge me? I have been waiting in this quarry for a thousand years for someone brave enough to step into my ring. Chat picks the punches. Ha! Too slow, pebble. Hold still!

boss.name: Big Rumble
boss.description: A booming, swaggering male pro-wrestling heel voice for a huge boulder brute boss in a cartoon fighting game. Loud, cocky, over-the-top playful trash talk, clear diction, American accent.
boss.sample: So, you think you can dodge me? I have been waiting in this quarry for a thousand years for someone brave enough to step into my ring. Chat picks the punches. Ha! Too slow, pebble. Hold still!

coach.name: Drill Coach
coach.description: A tough, barking but encouraging male boxing coach running pad work in a busy gym. Sharp, loud, punchy, very clear when counting combinations, British accent, adult.
coach.sample: Right, hands up, chin down! One-two! Good. One, one, two! Lovely. Slip, one-two! Keep breathing, stay light on your feet. Ten seconds left, push! And time. Brilliant work, take a breather.

coach.name: Hype Coach
coach.description: A high-energy, upbeat female fitness and boxing coach running pad work. Bright, enthusiastic, encouraging, very clear when counting combinations, American accent, adult.
coach.sample: Right, hands up, chin down! One-two! Good. One, one, two! Lovely. Slip, one-two! Keep breathing, stay light on your feet. Ten seconds left, push! And time. Brilliant work, take a breather.

coach.name: Corner Coach
coach.description: A warm, gritty older male boxing trainer in the corner of the ring. Calm authority, encouraging, steady and very clear when counting combinations, Irish accent.
coach.sample: Right, hands up, chin down! One-two! Good. One, one, two! Lovely. Slip, one-two! Keep breathing, stay light on your feet. Ten seconds left, push! And time. Brilliant work, take a breather.

coach.name: Pad Pro
coach.description: An energetic young female boxing pad-work coach. Fast, crisp, motivating and very clear when counting combinations, Australian accent.
coach.sample: Right, hands up, chin down! One-two! Good. One, one, two! Lovely. Slip, one-two! Keep breathing, stay light on your feet. Ten seconds left, push! And time. Brilliant work, take a breather.

taunt-round-start: Stand still. This won't hurt much.
I've been waiting all day for this.
My rocks are all warmed up.
Right then. Hands up, little one.
taunt-hit: That's going to leave a mark.
taunt-blocked: Are your arms made of stone too?
Next one goes round the side.
taunt-habit-left: I know where you're going. Left.
Lean left one more time. Go on.
taunt-habit-right: Your right side is all mine.
Lean right again. I dare you.
Right, is it? Writing that down.
taunt-super: Hear that? An avalanche is coming.
taunt-finisher: Okay, okay, I felt that one.
taunt-round-win: Chat wins! As it should be.
Back to the rubble with you.
Chat, we make a great team.
Don't cry. Here, have a pebble.
taunt-round-lose: I let you have that one.
I'm not crying. It's just gravel.
taunt-quiet-chat: Chat, I can't punch without you.

rest: Rest up. Stay light on your feet.
ten-seconds: Ten to go! Don't stop now!
missed: That's fine. Eyes on the pads.
faster: Pick it up! Chat says faster!
workout-done: That's the session! Proud of you.
And that's a wrap! Great work.

crowd-cheer.text: Short excited crowd cheer in a small arena, quick burst of applause and whoops

crowd-groan.text: Short disappointed crowd groan, a room of people going aww

pad-hit.text: Single boxing glove punch hitting a focus mitt, sharp leather thump, close up, dry

rest-whistle.text: Single short coach whistle blast in a gym

big-bell.text: Boxing ring bell, two loud metallic dings, end of round
